Your quilt starts with param torn squares: they cannot be covered and count as empty (board value 99).
The boss quilt starts with param leather squares already sewn on (board value 100).

intro.text: Welcome to the Parish Fair, dear. A quilt is nine squares by nine. Fill it before the clock runs out.
Buy a patch with buttons, sew it on, and your time token walks forward.
I will sit beside you. No hurry.

outro.text: Not a gap left behind. You have the eye for it.

opponent.name: Dame Poppy
opponent.personality: Kind and slow. Buys whatever fits first.

easier.text: The computer plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Dame Poppy won, but she is the kindest teacher at the fair. Fill the corners first and try again.

intro.text: Passing a button spot pays you for every button printed on your patches. Buy early, collect often.
I only look at the cheap patches. Cheap is good!

outro.text: Your little income is already humming.

opponent.name: Tilly Thimble
opponent.personality: Frugal. Never spends on big patches.

goal.text: Finish with at least -5 points and win.

easier.text: The computer plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Tilly spent fast and got rich slow. Look for patches with buttons early, then try again.

intro.text: Granny Fernsby has won the Parish ribbon for forty years.
Start with three extra buttons, do you? Cheeky. I will take the same.

outro.text: Well stitched, child. The county fair awaits.

opponent.name: Granny Fernsby
opponent.personality: Wise and tidy. Leaves few gaps.
opponent.taunt: A neat try. Come back when your corners are tidier.
opponent.praise: You sew like the old days. Go and win the county.

twist.text: Boss rule: Granny Fernsby starts with 3 extra buttons.

easier.text: The computer plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Not this year, child. Come back with a tidier quilt.
Granny Fernsby can be beaten. Fewer gaps, and Advance when you are short.

intro.text: County quilters watch the time track as closely as their cloth.
Fall behind and I will take every turn in a row.

outro.text: Hm. You waited for the right moment.

opponent.name: Odette Loom
opponent.personality: Hungry for income. Buys patches with buttons on them.

easier.text: The computer plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: The county gate stays shut for now. Buy cheap, quick patches to get more turns.

intro.text: Moths got into your quilt. Three squares are chewed through. Sorry about that.
Torn squares cannot be covered. Plan around them.

outro.text: You made the holes look like a design.

opponent.name: Bram Seam
opponent.personality: Blunt. Strong at fitting awkward shapes.

twist.text: Twist: three squares of your quilt are torn and can never be covered.

goal.text: Win with 3 torn squares in your quilt.

easier.text: The computer plays gently and the torn squares are gone.

outroLose.text: The moths won this round. Keep your quilt tidy and the twist hurts less.

intro.text: Marguerite Bodkin keeps the county ribbon on her wall.
Four buttons to start. I do not need them, but I like winning easily.

outro.text: Hm! Take your ribbon. Grand Fair next month.

opponent.name: Marguerite Bodkin
opponent.personality: Calm and precise. Rarely wastes time.
opponent.taunt: Pretty, but the ribbon stays with me.
opponent.praise: That was a proper quilt. The Grand Fair is yours to try.

twist.text: Boss rule: Marguerite starts with 4 extra buttons.

easier.text: The computer plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: The county ribbon stays with me.
She builds income early. Do the same, then try again.

intro.text: At the Grand Fair every quilter counts to the last square.
I count better than you. Let us see.

opponent.name: Ivo Selvage
opponent.personality: Counts every button. Hard to out-tempo.

easier.text: The computer plays at normal strength and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: The grand gates are tough. Watch who is behind on the track before you buy big.

intro.text: Three of my squares are already sewn. Call it a family tradition.
Out-fill her anyway. You have the better eye.

outro.text: Round and round I go. You were quicker.

opponent.name: Hester Pinwheel
opponent.personality: Cheerful but cunning. Loves big patches.

twist.text: Twist: Hester's quilt starts with 3 squares already sewn.

easier.text: The computer plays at normal strength and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: A head start for them, a lesson for you. Win the race to the gold spots next time.

intro.text: I have never left more than six squares empty in my life.
Then neither should you tonight.

outro.text: Seven squares and a smile. Fair play.

goal.text: Win with at most 6 empty squares.

easier.text: The computer plays at normal strength.

outroLose.text: Gaps, gaps, gaps. The tidy-quilt prize is mine.
Too many gaps for the tidy-quilt judge. Keep edges straight and try again.

intro.text: Queen Aurelia has never lost at the Grand Fair.
Three buttons to begin, and the best eye in the land. Sit down, little quilter.

outro.text: A new champion. I shall frame this quilt.

opponent.name: Queen Aurelia
opponent.taunt: Tidy, but a queen does not lose.
opponent.praise: Grand Champion. The hall is yours.

twist.text: Boss rule: Queen Aurelia starts with 3 extra buttons.

easier.text: The computer plays at normal strength and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: My crown stays on my head, little stitcher.
You came so far. One tidier quilt and that crown is yours.

pick: Marden swears no newcomer wins a ribbon. Prove them wrong: buy the long strip, 3 buttons.
drag: Lovely strip! Lay it on your quilt. Every empty square costs 2 at the judging.
sew: Snug fit. Sew it on: 3 buttons paid, and your token walks 3 spaces.
opp: You are ahead on the track now, so Marden moves. Watch the old fox.
adv: Marden is done. Low on buttons? Advance past Marden: 1 button per space.
end: Buttons in your pocket. Play on to the judging; I will whisper as we go.

prologue.endText: Marden looks worried already. Play this fair to the judging; Aunt Wren will chime in.

start: Marden swears no newcomer wins a ribbon. Buy any glowing patch, or Advance for buttons.
income_me: Pay day! You passed a gold spot: every button printed on your patches paid you {n}.
income_zero: A gold spot, but your patches carry no buttons yet, so it paid 0. Buy patches with buttons!
income_opp: Marden's patches just paid them. More buttons on your patches means a fatter pay day.
cant: Too dear for now! A patch you can't pay for stays dim. Advance to earn buttons.
again: Still behind Marden on the track, so you go again. Quick patches buy extra turns.
again_opp: Marden is still behind you, so Marden moves again. Big, slow patches give turns away.
leather_me: A leather scrap! You passed it first, so it is yours, free: put it on any empty square.
leather_opp: Marden passed a leather scrap first and sewed it on free. First to pass it gets it.
bonus: {name} filled a whole 7x7 block: the gold rosette, worth +7 at the judging!
late: Chapter 4: the fair closes soon. Fill gaps now: each empty square costs 2.
end_me: You reached the last space! Marden plays out their last moves, then the judges come.
end_opp: Marden reached the last space and waits. You keep playing until you get there too.
pick: Lay it on your quilt, then Sew it on. Every square left empty costs 2 at the judging.
buy_good: Good buy! It carries buttons, so it pays you at every gold spot on the track.
buy_big: A big patch: lots of squares filled at once. Big ones cost time, though.
buy_cheap: Cheap and quick: your token barely moves, so you may get the next turn too.
buy_poor: Slow and no buttons: that hands Marden extra turns. Cheaper, quicker patches next time.
adv_me: Advance: you hop just past Marden and take 1 button per space. Handy when you are broke.
who_next: Whoever is further back on the track moves next. Now that is Marden: watch.
opp_slow: Marden took a slow patch, so Marden's token jumped ahead: expect a few turns in a row.

final.win: Aunt Wren: Ten years I waited to see Marden lose a ribbon. Empty squares cost 2 each; you left fewer. Welcome to the fair!
final.lose: Aunt Wren: Marden wins this one, but you learned every rule. Empty squares cost 2 each; fill more next time.
final.tie: Aunt Wren: A dead heat! On a tie, whoever reached the end first takes the ribbon.
final.nobonus: Nobody filled a 7x7 block, so the +7 rosette stayed on the judges' table.
final.walk: Your score: {b} buttons + {x} bonus − {e} empty × 2 = {t}. Marden: {ob} + {ox} − {oe} × 2 = {ot}.

intro.easy: Poppy has brought cake and a sewing basket. Friendly match, ribbon at stake.
intro.normal: Marden has won this fair three years running and wants a fourth ribbon.
intro.hard: Aurelia, the county champion, never leaves a square empty. Good luck.

quick.win: The judges pin the ribbon on your quilt.
quick.lose: The ribbon goes to {name}. Fewer gaps next time.
quick.tie: A dead heat. The ribbon goes to whoever finished first.

later.income: Gold spots: passing one pays the buttons printed on your patches.
later.leather: Leather scraps: the first player to pass one sews a free 1x1 on at once.
later.cant: A patch you cannot pay for stays dim.
later.again: The player further back moves, so one player can take several turns in a row.
later.bonus: The first to fill a whole 7x7 block earns +7.
later.end: When one player reaches the last space, the other plays on until they get there too.
later.tie: On equal points, whoever reached the last space first wins.
